title: [RMMZ] Need child sprite s for a witch school game

posts.author: The_Eerie_One
posts.body:
Putting my horror game efforts on the back burner for a bit while I get the hang of RPGM better, and switching gears to create a cute little game where a girl goes to a witch school after being inspired by and buying Plue's Cute Fantasy Worlds tilesets. Plan for it to be a short and simple cute game, but I've run into the simple problem that there's not a lot of children sprites to populate even a small school with (searched the RTP and DLCs and couldn't find much).
I only need about 5 or so sprites total, like I said I want to keep it small and simple with just a handful of NPCs to talk to. Again just regular RTP~esque style kids sprites to tell apart from the adult witch/warlock teachers (luckily there's a few adult wizard/witch sprites in the RTP and I got more from a DLC set I originally bought just for the animations, so I got the teaching staff of the school covered). Ideally I'd love some with witch clothes already, but that's probably too large an ask so any child sprites will do and I'll just edit on little cloaks and hats.
Any help at all is very appreciated, thank you.
(This is for MZ, but I own XP and MV as well.)

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
I am slightly confused. Can't you just make more kid sprites using the built-in Character generator?
That creates the necessary sprite sheets and everything. And there are quite a few options without any DLCs needed.
If you haven't tried it yet, a quick search for RPG Maker MZ Character Generator results in a number of tutorials on YouTube.
Just curious why the Character Generator wasn't a viable option for you.
